title.zh: Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to 'distill' frontier models, too
title.en: Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to 'distill' frontier models, too

current_state.zh: Y Combinator's Garry Tan argues that US open-weight AI labs should be permitted to distill frontier models, igniting a Hacker News debate over training-data ethics, copyright, and the sustainability of proprietary frontier labs.
